name: Galileo
one_liner: Virtual primary care app, open around the clock, that also treats anxiety, depression and insomnia; $0–$99 a visit with partner plans.
best_for: People with UnitedHealthcare or another partner plan who want a primary care doctor who also treats anxiety and depression
People with mild anxiety, depression or insomnia who want medication or advice from their regular doctor online
People managing a chronic condition alongside mental health concerns
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People looking for weekly talk therapy
People with severe or complex mental illness who need a psychiatrist
short_description: Galileo is a virtual doctor's office for primary, urgent and chronic care that also treats anxiety, depression and insomnia.
long_description: Galileo is a virtual primary care service run through an app. Its doctors handle everyday and urgent problems, chronic conditions such as diabetes and high blood pressure, and mental health concerns including anxiety, depression and insomnia, with same- or next-day appointments and round-the-clock access. It is in network with UnitedHealthcare, including UnitedHealthcare individual and family ACA Marketplace plans that replaced Virtual First plans in 2025, and its sign-up lists Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Mexico and Molina Healthcare. With these plans a visit costs $0 to $99. People without insurance can pay a membership fee or per visit; the amounts are not published. Mental health care is part of primary care, not a separate therapy service, and specialist and lab referrals go through your insurance. There are no published studies of Galileo's service.
patient_summary: You download the Galileo app, add your insurance if you have it, and message or video-call a doctor, including about anxiety, depression or sleep. With UnitedHealthcare and some other plans a visit costs $0 to $99; without insurance you pay a membership or per-visit fee.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance ($0–$99/visit with partner plans); self-pay price not published
pricing.notes: Cost per visit depends on your plan. The app is free to download; people without insurance pay an annual or monthly membership for unlimited appointments, or per visit. Prescriptions start at $0 according to the App Store listing.

privacy.notes: Medical records fall under the medical group's HIPAA notice and are never sold, but the website and app policy allows interest-based advertising through ad networks; you can delete your data in the app.

seo.title: Galileo Health: Virtual Primary Care Review | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Galileo offers 24/7 virtual primary care with a personal care team. $0-99/visit. UnitedHealthcare in-network. Mental health support included.

faqs.a: A virtual primary care service where you get a personal care team (health advocate + lead provider) for ongoing care. Not a one-off telehealth service—Galileo is designed to be your primary care provider. 24/7 access via text, phone, or video.

faqs.q: Does Galileo offer mental health services?
faqs.a: Yes, but it's integrated into their primary care model. They treat anxiety, depression, and insomnia. The care team includes mental health specialists and social workers. It's not a standalone psychiatry service, but good for mental health as part of whole-person care.

Yes. As of 2025, Galileo is in-network with all UnitedHealthcare Individual & Family ACA Marketplace plans across all 50 states. Also available through some employer plans. Cash-pay option available at $0-99/visit.

faqs.q: How is Galileo different from K Health or Sesame?
faqs.a: Galileo assigns you a dedicated care team for longitudinal care—they know your history and coordinate everything. K Health and Sesame connect you to whoever's available. Galileo is better if you want a real ongoing relationship; the others are better for one-off visits.

primary_uses: Anxiety and depression care in primary care

availability.note: Available nationwide; in network with UnitedHealthcare, and lists Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Mexico and Molina Healthcare at sign-up. Adults 18+ create accounts and can add dependents.
